title: Exact tracked simulation
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, Boolean input word $x$, and time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the tracked machine started on $x$ and run for $1+2t$ steps reaches exactly the completed tracked configuration of the source machine after $t$ steps, with each tape's span bounded by the leftmost and rightmost head positions visited up to that time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
For every machine $M$, input $x$, and time $t$, running the tracked evaluator for $1 +
2t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ equals the completed tracked
configuration of the run of $M$ at time $t$ with the true leftmost and rightmost visited
bounds, including after the source has halted.
